name: Can room addition framing be done during any season in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: Can room addition framing be done during any season in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: While framing can technically occur year-round, the Bay Area's weather patterns can influence the process. Dry seasons (typically late spring through fall) are often ideal as they minimize risks of water damage to exposed lumber, which can lead to warping or mold. Wet winter months can cause delays due to rain, potentially increasing costs and extending timelines. However, experienced contractors can implement protective measures, such as temporary coverings, to mitigate weather impacts, allowing projects to proceed with careful planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framing can be done year-round, but dry seasons in the Bay Area are ideal to avoid water damage and delays. Wet weather may require protective measures.
